claims: The real indexed lookup previously took the first 32 broad union matches before applying topical ranking. In a repeatable corpus with shared generic vocabulary, the same relevant candidate at ordinal 73 was therefore absent in all 1800 enabled baseline samples across 100/10000/100000 candidates. All baseline lookups stayed within the deadline: this was a separate inclusion failure, not a deadline explanation.

The selector now requests the intersection of the existing bounded terms first, then uses the prior union query only when no complete lexical match exists. A maximum of 32 rows proceeds to existing domain/favorite/suppression/deduplication processing. Owner, boundary, expiry, current proposed state, input limits and the 10 ms total deadline remain unchanged. No graph scan, global frequency inference, trained model or schema mutation was added.

The independent storage regression creates more than 32 common-word candidates through real publication, then verifies the later specific record, partial-word fallback, foreign-owner/current-boundary exclusion and expiry. Three report tests verify at least 200 paired samples, preserved raw observations, latency/inclusion independence, invalid-measurement refusal and explicit missing provider/audio stages.

The benchmark creates only temporary synthetic databases. Each corpus has exactly N indexed candidates and two parent briefs; direct fixture seeding is not admission or acquisition proof. Real canonical prepared inputs and the actual repository/selector are used for 200 paired inputs per condition, with actual monotonic clocks, thread CPU when supported, resident memory and one synthetic WAL/FTS writer. Raw reports include method, seed, cache policy, hardware/OS/Node/power settings and measured source digests in successor runs.

Both successor corpus runs passed their local objectives and found the known relevant detail in all 1800 enabled samples each, without deadline misses. The final runner also preserves completed-corpus partial reports on interruption and rejects a writer that exits before readiness. Raw baseline and successor reports remain outside Git; no passing run replaces a failure.

limitations: This measures one independently authored known-match corpus shape with repeated paired inputs. It is not the canonical full semantic/held-out campaign, calibrated ranking, exploration allocation, or all current-turn wording. Partial union fallback remains bounded and cannot guarantee every relevant candidate will be among its first 32 matches.

Fresh SQLite connection is not operating-system page-cache cold, JIT/module cold or model cold. Background work is a single synthetic projection writer, not the actual selected-provider analysis workload. Model first-token output, audio/barge-in/continuity, GPU/provider pressure and Human quality were not measured. Full S084 performance qualification remains incomplete.

The earlier contended 29.346 ms Lab deadline miss remains preserved. Its exact contributor is unresolved; this separate corpus retrieval fix and passing full-suite successor do not retroactively explain it or promise deadline compliance under every load.
